STATE OF MAINE looks nicely primed third up and is already a two time Hamilton winner. THOUGHTFUL and BRUZANI are both back in trip but are hard fit and in good form at this level. ON THE MAP failed to fire in town last start but is better suited here. SERIN has just the one win on the record but did run well fresh last prep and is in a new stable here.

raceTips.comment: Bruzani has been in top form this preparation and thrives on heavy ground. He easily defeated key rival Thoughtful when they met at Donald. State of Maine should be at her peak now third-up and racing on her home track. She ran well at Coleraine last start and maps for a great run from the inside draw. Serin is an interesting runner first-up without any trials. His best form with previous trainers is encouraging for this class.

formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover throughout. Near the 400m was bumped inwards and then was momentarily eased when placed close to the heels. When questioned regarding her riding from near the 1000m and if there was an opportunity to race in a three wide position, apprentice explained that the mare was inclined to lay out from near the 800m, and for this reason raced in a four wide position. Apprentice was advised she should have made a greater effort to position her mount closer to runner to her inside near the 1000m.

bestBets.overview: Tricky draw for ROCKCLIFF but he is racing very well at this level. KENTATHAN is up in grade but down in weight having performed well when resuming; his second up record is solid. CHELSEA TOFF can also race well second up and will appreciate a return to grass. AUSSIE PHAROAH was luckless first up last time in, quickly into consistent form. DERELICT hasn't been too far off the placegetters at his last couple in similar company. TWO KAY KLICK can pull out a run fresh. THE LAST JUDGEMENT has again drawn out but he loves the heavy.

raceTips.comment: Chelsea Toff tends to improve second-up and happy to forgive last start on the synthetic track at Ballarat. She has a powerful finish and could be suited if they are racing off the fence late in the day. Rockcliff has been racing well this campaign and should be highly competitive again. Kentahten ran well first-up at Bairnsdale and looks well placed in this class.
